The image shows a large pool in the foreground, surrounded by a white building with a red roof. The pool is rectangular and has a small diving board at one end. There are several people standing around the pool, some of whom are wearing swimsuits.

In the background, there are several trees and bushes, as well as a few other buildings. The sky is blue and clear, suggesting a sunny day.

Overall, the image appears to be a photograph of a resort or hotel pool area, possibly taken during the daytime.
